reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness): alert-TP — resolved sink value is rememberMeKey derived from new java.util.Random().nextLong() assigned to session attribute and stored in secure cookie (L102). Alert 2 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value includes cookie.getValue() (derived from user cookie input via URL decoding at L76) concatenated into response output at L111-L116. User input reaches XSS sink directly. Both alerts represent real vulnerabilities.
